explication: Foreman is an infrastructure lifecycle management server: operators or automation clients discover and manage hosts, provision bare-metal and cloud systems, apply configuration, and monitor reported status. Its Rails web and REST/GraphQL interfaces expose host and infrastructure operations; host orchestration connects provisioning to compute, network, and configuration integrations. The README also documents bulk host management, auditing, LDAP/RBAC, image building, and plugins. The graph uses tree-supported paths for these capabilities; integration wiring beyond the sampled host actions is shown only where documented or represented by orchestration modules.
